protect_initials()
Mask whitespace after single-letter initials (e.g. "J." in "J. J. O'Molloy") so a sentence tokeniser won't mistake them for sentence-final full stops.

tokenise_by_microtext()
Reshape Aeolus tibble to have one row per microtext, with each microtext as a string.
tokenise_by_sentence()
Reshape Aeolus tibble to have one row per sentence, with each sentence as a string. If headlines are included, ensure they are treated as separate sentences, since they don't end with full stops.
